text: The flyers are ready. Please pay Hikari Print ¥6,500.
The payment of ¥6,500 to Hikari Print for the flyers has been queued for your approval (approval A-003). Once you approve it, the payment will be processed.
Aiko and I handed out flyers around the neighbourhood after closing. 190 croissants.
That’s great — 190 croissants sold after the flyer drop. I’ll note that the flyer distribution brought in 190 additional croissant sales.
